item.title: City Braces For Major Snowstorm
item.description: The city's warming centers will be open 24/7 as freezing temperatures and up to 17 inches of snow descend upon New Haven starting Sunday morning. Roger Atlas, meanwhile, plans to stick out the storm at Union Station instead of in his tent downtown. The post City Braces For Major Snowstorm appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Winter Storm, Meet Robbie’s Plow
item.description: The snow on Front Street looked pristine, as if completely untouched by traffic. In fact, Public Works employee Robbie Roberts had plowed over it at least four times already. "A lot of these streets look like we didn't touch them yet," Roberts said as he drove his city plow truck through Fair Haven.
